title: Sloth reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tree branch -->
  <rect x='8' y='72' width='84' height='10' rx='5' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='8' y='72' width='84' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A87B52'/>
  
  <!-- Sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#B8A07A'/>
  
  <!-- Sloth head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#C8B08A'/>
  
  <!-- Face mask (lighter area) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#E0D0B0'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='32' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='32' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='31' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#4A3828'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M46 41 Q50 44 54 41' stroke='#4A3828' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Arms holding book -->
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d='M32 48 Q28 55 32 62' stroke='#B8A07A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M68 48 Q72 55 68 62' stroke='#B8A07A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Book - open -->
  <!-- Left page -->
  <path d='M33 58 L50 62 L50 78 L33 74 Z' fill='#F5F0E0'/>
  <!-- Right page -->
  <path d='M67 58 L50 62 L50 78 L67 74 Z' fill='#FFFEF5'/>
  <!-- Spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#C4A882' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Book cover edges -->
  <path d='M33 58 L50 62 L50 78 L33 74 Z' fill='none' stroke='#D4B896' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M67 58 L50 62 L50 78 L67 74 Z' fill='none' stroke='#D4B896' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Book cover bottom edge -->
  <path d='M31 58 L33 58 L33 74 L31 74 Z' fill='#C0543A'/>
  <path d='M69 58 L67 58 L67 74 L69 74 Z' fill='#C0543A'/>
  
  <!-- Text lines on pages -->
  <line x1='36' y1='64' x2='47' y2='67' stroke='#A09080' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='68' x2='47' y2='71' stroke='#A09080' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='67' x2='64' y2='64' stroke='#A09080' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='71' x2='64' y2='68' stroke='#A09080' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Hand paws on book -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='62' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#C8B08A'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='62' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#C8B08A'/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='28' r='4' fill='#C8B08A'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='28' r='4' fill='#C8B08A'/>
  
  <!-- Hair tuft -->
  <path d='M48 20 Q50 16 52 20' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Feet dangling -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='74' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#B8A07A'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='74' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#B8A07A'/>
  
  <!-- Claws on feet -->
  <line x1='37' y1='77' x2='36' y2='80' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='77' x2='40' y2='80' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='77' x2='44' y2='80' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='77' x2='56' y2='80' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='77' x2='60' y2='80' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='77' x2='64' y2='80' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
